entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: A prisoner of fate to a future that has[n]been sealed in advance.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: This is truly an unjust game... Your[n]chances of winning are almost none.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: But if my voice is reaching you, there may[n]yet be a possibility open to you...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I beg you. Please overcome this game...[n]and save the world...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: The key to victory lies within the[n]memories of your bonds—the truth[n]that you and your friends grasped.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: It all began that day... when the game[n]was started half a year ago...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: For the sake of your world's future...[n]as well as your own... you must[n]remember...
